title: Between August 31 and September 05, 2026, as many as ...
snippet:
Between August 31 and September 05, 2026, as many as 23 Indian startups from diverse sectors raised over $291 million in funding from investors.  
  
These sectors include Cleantech, Healthtech, AI, Fintech, Semiconductors, Foodtech, Spacetech, Aerospace, Education, Electronics, Defense, Cosmetics, Wellness, and Footwear.  
  
Last week, Indian startups raised over $215 million, with Third Wave Coffee raising $42.7 million alone.

title: Best Startup Sectors in India to Invest In for High Growth (2026 Guide)
snippet:
FinTech, HealthTech, and Deep Tech/AI are among the strongest sectors for high-growth startup investment in 2026, driven by India’s digital infrastructure buildout, demographic tailwinds, and strong policy support. CleanTech is also a compelling long-term bet given India’s Net Zero commitments.

Is it safe to invest in Indian startups? [...] Cybersecurity: As India’s digital economy expands, cybersecurity becomes critical infrastructure. Indian cybersecurity SaaS is growing at 35%+ annually.

Blue Economy: India has 7,500 km of coastline and a fishing community of 10+ million. Startups in aquaculture tech, maritime logistics, and port management are still largely untapped.
